name: Anisotropic Reflective Spherical 3D Gaussian Splatting
definition: A method that embeds Anisotropic Spherical Gaussians (ASG) within a Physically Based Rendering (PBR) pipeline, aligning them with GGX microfacet models to model environmental illumination and enable accurate mesh reconstruction via light-transport simulation.
summary: Anisotropic Reflective Spherical 3D Gaussian Splatting is a differentiable rendering method that embeds Anisotropic Spherical Gaussians in a PBR pipeline to accurately model specular reflections and material properties, unlike standard Gaussian Splatting.
